profile.research_note:
Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 34 (CoreSite missing-address campaign): added an operator-confirmed address, noted the shared street address with the non-target NY2 building, applied a two-source-corroborated confirmed-complete MW figure to critical_it_mw. research_status remains complete.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CoreSite was founded in 2001 as CRG West, rebranded to CoreSite in 2009, went public in 2010, and was acquired by American Tower in December 2021. As of June 2022 CoreSite operated 27 data center facilities across 10 markets totaling over 4.6 million net rentable square feet, with New York City among its key markets. This specific building, NY3, is CoreSites third Secaucus, New Jersey building in the New York market. CoreSites own current New York regional page (operator source, tier-1) gives this building an address of 2 Emerson Lane, Secaucus, NJ 07094, with 138,000 plus square feet. This is the same street address as CoreSites separate NY2 building on the same Secaucus campus, NY2 is not itself a row in this registry, so this shared address reflects two buildings on one campus site rather than a mapping error. Data Center Dynamics trade press (tier-4, covering this buildings launch) corroborates the address and gives more than 138,000 sq ft (12,820 sqm) and around 15 MW of capacity, reporting the facility completed construction in late September 2025, after being announced in late 2023 with an originally targeted Q4 2024 completion that slipped. DataCenterMap independently shows 15 MW as well. Since this is a confirmed, already completed single building figure corroborated by two independent sources rather than a future projection or a campus total, it is applied to critical_it_mw.
